title: PteraXpansion
description: An End Update, redstone mechanics and new challenges!
body:
**PteraXpansion** is a new mod adding multiple additions Mojang will never add, such as: an End Update, a Redirector, an Auto-Mining Block, and much, much more.


<details>
<summary>Wasteland (Spoiler)</summary>

In the end, the only vanilla island that still generates is the central dragon island. However, there is a new biome, known as... The Wasteland, this biome is filled with Blazes, Blood Slimes, and Black Blazes. You may also find Grimstone Boulders and Obsidian Obelisks
![The New Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20a1f6ef80d4958360dcc0bfc91761248c814d5b_0.webp)


<details>
<summary>Blood Slime</summary>

The Blood Slime attacks an mob/player when that mob/player attacks something, even if the victim the mob/player attacked was not the Blood Slime. He gets stronger each time he kills a mob/player. Blood Slimeballs are dropped from this mob.

![Blood Slime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7c26f9e2a1cf47997e7a8a6f02301dcd109d6a1.png)

Combining a Blood Slimeball with a stick makes the agility gadget. Which can then be combined with another stick to make an Agility Gadget with Long or with an Ender Pearl so it makes an Agility-Gadget with Ender-launch, you cal also combine the 2 together.

![Jumping extremely high with the use of an Agility Gadget with Long-Jump](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/464d3150911a8393fff0b70f10418c173ff3e7a6_0.webp)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Black Blaze</summary>

The Black Blaze has a shield. You can break his shield or attack him from behind or from above. He does have a cooldown phase where he makes all nearby blazes aggro at you while he is under a cooldown.

![Black Blaze](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a05b88b341d72c3dd9be02b211dd853be462c630_0.webp)
  
</details>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Miner Block</summary>

is a new block which based on the side of the block it is placed on, will mine a specific side. It is activated with redstone

</details>


<details>
<summary>Redirector (Spoiler)</summary>

It will turn around until it looks at a player or Iron Golem, when looking at one, it will cause all nearby mobs (even passive ones) to attack the player/Iron Golem, only mobs that are tamed to the player are unaffected

![Redirector](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ed350acb5f3052dae358a2549396ddae2c1900d.png)

</details>
